services.name: Makana Charters
services.desc: During your time on Kauai, you do not want to miss a Na Pali Coast tour. Guests and locals alike constantly remind us that it is some of the most inspiring and breathtaking views in the world. But if you’ve never been to Kauai before you might find it hard to choose the right activity. While some may choose a tour from the air, we think the only way to feel immersed in the coastline is to see it by boat. But even then the decision can be difficult with so many different boat tour operators. We hope that you will choose Makana Charters and tell us afterward that it was a highlight of your time on Kauai, and join thousands of other happy guests who have told us just that. services.name: sunset cruise
services.desc: It’d be an understatement to say that a Napali Coast sunset cruise is a “paradise” on Kauai. There are no words to describe the sheer beauty, magnitude, and awe-inspiring landscapes along Kauai’s coveted coastline. Thousands of tourists flock to Kauai every year to see and experience the Napali Coast in particular. So why does the Napali Coast stand out compared to the many prominent tourist locations on the island? And what’s the best way to access it? The words “Na Pali” literally mean “The Cliffs”. services.name: What if I don’t want to snorkel?
services.desc: No. The sunset cruise covers the coastline, sea caves, and Honopū Arch during the golden-hour window, but there’s no snorkel stop on this tour. If snorkeling matters more to you than sunset light, our standard morning tour includes a roughly one-hour snorkel stop

services.name: see Humpback whales
services.desc: Dolphins show up along this route often enough that guests ask about them regularly, though we never promise a sighting, since the ocean doesn’t work that way. What we can offer is a crew that’s spent years learning where dolphins tend to gather along these waters, and that’s as true on the sunset run as on any other
